mapper.sql: a.article_id, a.bbs_master_id, a.category_id, a.file_group_id, a.writer_user_id, a.writer_user_type, a.writer_name, a.writer_password, a.title, a.content, a.press_name, a.link_url, a.published_at, a.notice_yn, a.secret_yn, a.view_count, a.like_count, a.report_count, a.comment_count, a.client_ip, a.status, a.delete_yn, a.created_by, a.created_ip, a.created_at, a.updated_by, a.updated_ip, a.updated_at, m.bbs_code AS bbs_code, m.bbs_name AS bbs_name, m.bbs_type AS bbs_type, m.site_id AS site_id, s.site_code AS site_code, m.comment_yn AS commentYn, m.file_yn AS fileYn, cat.category_code AS category_code, cat.category_name AS category_name, (SELECT f.file_id FROM tb_file f WHERE f.file_group_id = a.file_group_id AND f.delete_yn = 'N' AND f.is_image_yn = 'Y' AND f.virus_scan_status IN ('CLEAN','PENDING') ORDER BY f.created_at ASC, f.file_id ASC LIMIT 1) AS cover_file_id

ORDER BY a.notice_yn DESC, a.created_at DESC

SELECT a.article_id, a.title, a.created_at FROM tb_bbs_article a WHERE a.bbs_master_id = #{bbsMasterId} AND a.delete_yn = 'N' AND a.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND (a.created_at < #{createdAt} OR (a.created_at = #{createdAt} AND a.article_id < #{articleId})) ORDER BY a.created_at DESC, a.article_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT a.article_id, a.title, a.created_at FROM tb_bbs_article a WHERE a.bbs_master_id = #{bbsMasterId} AND a.delete_yn = 'N' AND a.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND (a.created_at > #{createdAt} OR (a.created_at = #{createdAt} AND a.article_id > #{articleId})) ORDER BY a.created_at ASC, a.article_id ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_bbs_article ( article_id, bbs_master_id, category_id, file_group_id, writer_user_id, writer_user_type, writer_name, writer_password, title, content, press_name, link_url, published_at, notice_yn, secret_yn, view_count, like_count, report_count, comment_count, client_ip, status, delete_yn, created_by, created_ip, created_at, updated_by, updated_ip, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{articleId}, #{bbsMasterId}, #{categoryId}, #{fileGroupId}, #{writerUserId}, #{writerUserType}, #{writerName}, #{writerPassword}, #{title}, #{content}, #{pressName}, #{linkUrl}, #{publishedAt}, #{noticeYn}, #{secretYn}, #{viewCount}, #{likeCount}, #{reportCount}, #{commentCount}, #{clientIp}, #{status}, #{deleteYn}, #{createdBy}, #{createdIp}, NOW(), #{updatedBy}, #{updatedIp}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_bbs_article SET title=#{title}, content=#{content}, press_name=#{pressName}, link_url=#{linkUrl}, published_at=#{publishedAt}, writer_name=#{writerName}, secret_yn=#{secretYn}, notice_yn=#{noticeYn}, category_id=#{categoryId}, updated_by=#{updatedBy}, updated_ip=#{updatedIp}, updated_at=NOW() WHERE article_id = #{articleId} AND delete_yn = 'N'
UPDATE tb_bbs_article SET delete_yn = 'Y', status = 'DELETED', updated_at = NOW() WHERE article_id = #{articleId} AND delete_yn = 'N'
UPDATE tb_bbs_article SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE article_id = #{articleId} AND delete_yn = 'N'
UPDATE tb_bbs_article SET notice_yn = #{noticeYn}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE article_id = #{articleId} AND delete_yn = 'N'
UPDATE tb_bbs_article SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE article_id = #{articleId} AND delete_yn = 'N'
UPDATE tb_bbs_article SET like_count = GREATEST(like_count + #{delta}, 0) WHERE article_id = #{articleId} AND delete_yn = 'N'
UPDATE tb_bbs_article SET report_count = GREATEST(report_count + #{delta}, 0) WHERE article_id = #{articleId} AND delete_yn = 'N'
UPDATE tb_bbs_article SET status = 'REPORTED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE article_id = #{articleId} AND delete_yn = 'N' AND status = 'PUBLISHED'
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tb_bbs_article a JOIN tb_bbs_master m ON m.bbs_master_id = a.bbs_master_id LEFT JOIN tb_site s ON s.site_id = m.site_id LEFT JOIN tb_bbs_category cat ON cat.category_id = a.category_id AND cat.delete_yn = 'N' WHERE a.delete_yn = 'N' ORDER BY a.created_at ASC

SELECT FROM tb_bbs_article a JOIN tb_bbs_master m ON m.bbs_master_id = a.bbs_master_id LEFT JOIN tb_site s ON s.site_id = m.site_id LEFT JOIN tb_bbs_category cat ON cat.category_id = a.category_id AND cat.delete_yn = 'N' WHERE a.delete_yn = 'N' AND a.created_by = #{createdBy} AND a.status <> 'DELETED' ORDER BY a.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_bbs_article WHERE delete_yn = 'Y' AND updated_at <= #{cutoff}
